target_customer: Finance teams at borderless African businesses that move money across accounts, payment providers and currencies
problem: Finance teams in African cross border businesses juggle many bank accounts, payment service providers and accounting tools without one ledger. Nash offers a ledger based finance operating system to connect them.
business_model: B2B SaaS finance platform (pricing not found)
product_category: Finance operations and treasury software for Africa

founders.name: Anthony Wagacha
prior_employers: Bank of America Merrill Lynch (investment banker, New York)
founders.background_notes: From the YC company page, which lists him as the only founder; he has designed financial products for institutions in Africa.

technical_complexity.rationale: A multi currency ledger with integrations to bank, PSP and accounting systems across African markets is standard fintech engineering with hard integration work.

defensibility.rationale: Ledger and treasury tools create some switching costs once finance teams integrate, but no sourced evidence of traction or proprietary access at founding.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Not established by sources; no news of a copy or acquisition found.

market_need_then: The YC description states a mission of enabling borderless commerce in Africa. No quantified demand evidence was found in sources opened.

branding.domain_note: Operated on getnashglobal.com, not nash.com; the domain now redirects to a HugeDomains sale page (checked 2026), so the site is dead.

brand_strength.rationale: No brand press found; a generic name needing a 'global' domain suffix and shared with other companies called Nash.

outcome_analysis: Nash joined YC in Winter 2022 with a solo founder from finance backgrounds. The YC directory still lists it as active, but its website domain now redirects to a domain sale page, which suggests the product may no longer operate, though no shutdown report was found. Funding is only seen on aggregators, so the trajectory is unknown and no cause of failure can be asserted.
notes: Startuplist.africa lists a $100K seed announced 2022-03-29 and Village.ai lists $600K total; both are aggregators with conflicting figures, so neither is recorded as a round (unverified). Crunchbase lists Lione Alushula as co-founder; I did not open a company source so he is not listed as a founder. Website redirects to a HugeDomains page (dead site). No shutdown or acquisition news found in an outcome search. No dated competitors found for the batch. Completeness pass: recorded a seed announced 2022-03-29 from Startuplist.africa (single database, amount field blank; its total raised is 100K, Village.ai says 600K). Co-founder Lione Alushula is named only by aggregator summaries, so not added.
